config.hint401Title: Push rejected by on-premise server (401 — unauthorized)
config.hint401Body: The on-premise server rejected the request. Common causes: (1) installation never provisioned or was factory-reset — use the "Provisioning" button on the installation page to regenerate API keys; (2) API key in the central is outdated after a manual change on the on-premise — rotate the API key from the installation page; (3) tenant not yet registered on the on-premise — re-provision the installation, then use "Resync" to republish configurations.

config.docIntro: Configurations are pushed from the central to the on-prem. The client (mobile app, web, totem) reads them directly from the on-prem via REST API.
config.docAuthBody: Every request must include the X-API-Key header with a READ or WRITE key associated to the product (tenant). Keys are managed on the on-prem database.
config.docParamEntity: entity (optional, default: base) — name of the entity to read
config.docResponseBody: The response is a JSON object with a payload field containing the AES-256-GCM encrypted configuration in Base64.
config.docDecryptBody: To decrypt the payload you need the Payload Master Key of the installation, visible (and rotatable) in the Security section of the installation page.

base.confirmLeaveIfDirtyLabel: confirmLeaveIfDirty — ask for confirmation before leaving without saving
base.idHint: Free identifier, usually matching the name of the mobile entity it will be saved on.

dataSource.detectedArraysTip: Detected nested arrays — click to use them as arrayPath:
dataSource.detectedFieldsTip: Detected fields in the array — click to add them to fields:
dataSource.coalescePathsHint: Comma-separated paths, in priority order. Returns the first non-empty value (null/empty string/empty map/empty array all count as empty). format is not applicable here.
dataSource.dateTimeLabelTip: dateLabel converts an ISO 8601 string into a full localized date label (e.g. "Saturday, July 18 2026"); timeLabel into "HH:mm" (language-independent).
dataSource.defaultDateRangeTip: If the descriptor uses a date filter (filterBar), pre-populates fromField/toField in state on first load. daysAgo/daysForward are relative to today.
dataSource.invalidJsonError: Invalid JSON — check that you pasted the entire response.
dataSource.nestedArraysLabel: The response contains nested arrays (2+ levels) → flattenNested is needed
dataSource.noFetchTip: If absent, the screen starts with no initial fetch (static sections only).
dataSource.noNestedArraysError: No nested array found (2+ levels) — flattenNested is probably not needed for this response.
dataSource.rootFieldsTip: Brings root-level fields from the response (e.g. a settings id) directly into state, useful for a subsequent onSubmit that needs to reference that id in its endpoint.
dataSource.sampleResponseGeneralTip: Optional, never saved in the configuration: paste the endpoint's sample response here to preview resolved values next to fields that use paths (itemsPath, groupsPath, arrayPath, matchField...).
dataSource.title: Initial data source (optional)
dataSource.bareArrayTip: If this endpoint's response is a bare JSON array (e.g. [{...},{...}], with no wrapper object), the mobile engine automatically wraps it in the state as {"items": [...]}. In this case, in the table/list sections reading this data set itemsPath to items (already proposed as default).
dataSource.wrapAsSingleGroupOption: wrapAsSingleGroup — wrap a flat array in a group (for cardList/groupedTable)
dataSource.wrapAsSingleGroupTip: cardList/groupedTable always require already-grouped data (an array of groups, each with a sub-list). If your endpoint returns a flat array (e.g. a list of categories), use this transform to wrap it in a single group before connecting it to the section.
dataSource.staticItemFieldsTitle: Static fields added to every item (staticItemFields)
dataSource.staticItemFieldsTip: Map of fixed fields (not coming from the backend) merged into every item, useful for a fixed icon/type/color to use in the card.
dataSource.groupLabelKeyEmptyHint: If left empty: no reserved header row above the first group (a "flat" list).

fieldComponents.infoBannerButtonTip: buttonKey/actionMessageKey: if you declare primaryAction.sequence, the button actually performs the calls; otherwise it only shows a placeholder snackbar (actionMessageKey, default common.featureComingSoon).
fieldComponents.infoBannerLinkTip: linkKey: if infoDialog is filled in, tapping opens an informational dialog; otherwise it only shows a placeholder snackbar (the link never runs a sequence).
fieldComponents.loadMoreLabelKeyTip: If set, the options endpoint must reference the current page with the placeholder {{id}_page} (e.g. ...&page={selectedDoctor_page}).

pathPreview.notFound: Not found in the sample response

sections.advancedAttrsTip: Advanced attributes (filterButton, badgeMap, rowDetail, tabs...) can be edited in the raw JSON view of the last step, preserving the structure already created here.
sections.emptyTip: No sections yet — add one using the buttons above.
sections.linkUrlTip: ⚠ linkUrl does not actually open anything (placeholder not implemented on the engine side).
sections.listRowTip: Every row is always a switch — no other row type is supported.
sections.menuIconsTip: Valid icons (closed whitelist of 12): {{icons}}. Any other value → silent fallback to "arrow_forward".
sections.title: Screen sections
sections.itemsPathTip: Must match the state field where the array lives. If the dataSource returns a bare array (not an object), the engine wraps it automatically as "items" — keep the default "items" in that case.
sections.searchableFieldsHint: List of column names (key) to enable text search on. If empty, the table does not show the search box.
sections.cardElementsToggle: Use free layout (card.elements) instead of fixed fields
sections.cardElementsTip: Free layout: compose the card with atomic elements (title, subtitle, text, keyValue, date, badge, chip, favorite, icon, divider, spacer) and row/column containers to arrange them freely — no new Dart code required. Enabling this ignores the fixed fields below (titleField/subtitleField/...) at the engine level.
sections.cardBadgeMapTip: badgeMap (value → {labelKey, color} map) is not editable here: add it in the raw JSON view of the last step.
sections.cardIconMapTip: Static icon: use the fields above. For an icon that varies by field value, add field + iconMap in the raw JSON view of the last step.
sections.leftBorderToggle: Left vertical colored border (fixed primary color)
sections.leftBorderFieldHint: Alternative to the fixed color: item field name whose value determines the color (see map below). If the value is not in the map, the border falls back to the primary color.
sections.sortableFieldsTip: Adds a sort icon next to the search box; sorting applies within each group (not across different groups). Automatically recognizes dd/MM/yyyy dates.
sections.rowCrossAxisHint: Useful to vertically align an icon next to a text (e.g. "center").
sections.filterButtonTip: Filter button with bottom sheet: one or more groups, each either derived from a field (distinct values computed at runtime) or with static options.
sections.filterGroupModeTip: Mode A — dynamic: set "field" (optional labelField/colorField) and leave the options below empty: the engine computes distinct values at runtime. Mode B — static: leave "field" empty and define the options below explicitly.
sections.filterOptionsLabel: Static options (used only if "field" is empty):
sections.iconNameHint: Free name: any standard Material icon (~8800 available, e.g. medical_services, sports_soccer, directions_run).
sections.dateBadgeTip: "Big day + abbreviated month" box for event/calendar lists. The field must be a date in dd/MM/yyyy format (otherwise the element is not shown, no crash). The month is always translated via the common.monthsShort.1..12 keys — leave monthKeyPrefix empty unless you need a different translation namespace.
sections.dateBadgeBorderedTip: By default (checkbox off) there is no box at all: just day+month stacked. Enable this option (or set a background/border color) to show the square box. Day and month use the same color by default (dayColor), if monthColor is empty.
sections.verticalDividerTip: Vertical separator between a dateBadge/icon and the content next to it in a row. Height adapts automatically to the tallest sibling in the row: no fixed value to configure.
sections.calendarItemsPathTip: itemsPath must point to a flat (non-grouped) array in state. dateField reads a date in dd/MM/yyyy[ HH:mm] format: items with an invalid date are excluded from the calendar (no crash).
sections.calendarCardLabel: Card for each event in the list below the calendar
sections.calendarTip: Suggested: row with dateBadge + verticalDivider + column (title/time), same pattern as the "Scheduled events" list. Required translations (no default): common.monthsFull.1..12 and common.weekdaysShort.1..7.

sequence.bodyMappingTip: bodyMapping — field/expression pairs merged into the sent body:
sequence.captureMappingTip: captureMapping — saves pieces of the response into the flow state:
sequence.captureOptionsLabel: captureOptions — build an options list (for a remote dropdown/radioCardList) from the response and save it in state

snackbar.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically — select and copy manually
snackbar.resolveErrorsFirst: Resolve {{count}} blocking error(s) first (see panel on the right)

steps.cancelActionLabel: cancelAction — cancels with a confirmation dialog
steps.cancelBodyMappingTip: ⚠ bodyMapping: here "@." only supports "@.patientId" — "@.userId" silently resolves to null.
steps.dataSourcePingLabel: dataSource "ping" — the response is discarded, useful only as a server-side warm-up
steps.downloadActionLabel: downloadAction — downloads a file (e.g. a reminder)
steps.introTip: Every step supports field/canProceed/next, advanced prefetch (dataSource "ping" + prefetchSequence) and, on the last step, single or sequence submission + a dedicated conclusion screen.
steps.isLastStepLabel: This is the last step (shows onSubmit instead of "next")
steps.payActionLabel: payAction — opens an external payment URL (the only action actually implemented)
steps.prefetchSequenceTip: prefetchSequence — chained calls executed before showing the step; an error here blocks the step with an error/retry screen:
steps.reviewFieldsHint: Last step only: ids of fields (collected in this or previous steps) to show in a read-only summary before the final confirmation.
steps.showConclusionLabel: Show a dedicated conclusion screen (recap + post-confirmation actions)
steps.title: Flow steps
steps.visibleIfHint: Hides the step's title/description and footer buttons (not the fields, which remain governed by their own individual visibleIf).

submit.bodyMappingTip: "$.field" reads from state — "@." is not supported here (use {patientId}/{userId} in the endpoint).
submit.multipartTip: Enables an alternative branch for uploading a file (filePicker) as a real multipart/form-data request, instead of a JSON body. bodyMapping is only available for simple text fields here (no requestTransform/nested structures).
submit.requestTransformTip: unflattenNested: converts a flat array (already in bodyMapping) into an array of objects with only the selected fields, applied after bodyMapping and before sending.
submit.requestTransformCustomTip: Custom transform "{{type}}" with hardcoded logic in the engine: not editable from this wizard, preserved as-is in the published JSON.
submit.showSuccessScreenTip: Alternative to messageKey/navigateBack: takes priority if present. The "summary" field is available only here (not in flow last steps).
submit.title: Saving (onSubmit)

translations.checklistTip: Every *Key must exist in smh_it/smh_en/smh_es, otherwise the raw key is shown on screen.
translations.title: Translation checklist

dataLoss.title: Warning: some manually added data is not handled by this wizard
dataLoss.description: This entity contains JSON attributes the wizard cannot edit/regenerate. If you save from here without addressing them, they will be removed from the published JSON:
